documents.limitation: The README is a separate condensed publication and does not replace the complete manual or its detailed instructions.

verified_states: grey: passive and unavailable for lane guidance
green: active and available for lane guidance
amber: corrective steering intervention in progress
amber OFF: switched off; availability depends on country
amber with message: unavailable; camera obstruction, damage or fault are possible causes
reviewed_sections.catalogue_action: Grey, green and amber-intervention states were scoped individually. The amber exclamation-mark unavailable state was added to the established unavailable semantic card after exact visual comparison. The amber OFF variant remains pending an exact reusable OFF asset.

reviewed_sections.operating_condition: Warnings are displayed only above 70 km/h; the system has stated limits and does not replace driver attention.
verified_states: level 1: white cup, text and acoustic warning; break recommended
level 2: red cup, text and acoustic warning; break as soon as possible
level 3: red cup, text and acoustic warning; significant hazard, stop as quickly as possible and take a break immediately
time-based: white cup after 4.5 hours uninterrupted driving without detected fatigue signs; break recommended
limited: amber cup, text and acoustic warning; fault/malfunction, restart drive readiness and seek workshop if persistent
unavailable: amber cup plus amber central warning, text and sound; fault/malfunction or system limits, restart/check settings and seek workshop if persistent
reviewed_sections.signal_note: The manual describes the indicators as displayed or illuminated with text and sound; it does not describe these reviewed fatigue states as flashing.
reviewed_sections.catalogue_action: All six meanings are kept separate in pending evidence. No customer card is published because the reusable public-domain cup differs visibly from the exact Terramar cup and OEM artwork reuse rights are not established.

reviewed_sections.verified_state: The amber eye/exclamation graphic is used with text and sound for unavailable/fault states.
reviewed_sections.catalogue_action: Pending only: the local eye-only licensed drawing lacks the exclamation mark and is not an exact graphic match.
Three states remain separately pending exact dynamic/combined graphics. No Audi or generic single sign card is substituted.
verified_states: speed warning level 1: detected road sign flashes continuously in the cluster/HUD when the detected maximum speed is exceeded; this paragraph states no sound
speed warning level 2: if speeding continues, the same sign flashes continuously and an acoustic warning sounds until the driver actively reduces speed

extended traffic-sign recognition unavailable: white system indicator plus amber central warning and text; camera, fault, speed-warning, navigation-data and operating-area causes are separately described
green: active distance control and adaptive lane guidance
partly green: active Travel Assist, passive distance control and adaptive lane guidance
grey: deactivated, no control
amber with message: unavailable or unexpected operation
white hands-on-wheel: take over steering
red hands-on-wheel: take over steering immediately
reviewed_sections.catalogue_action: White and red takeover requests were scoped individually. Three composite operating states and amber unavailability remain pending exact reusable composite graphics.

verified_states: steady red vehicle outline with exclamation: propulsion unavailable; stop safely and obtain professional help
steady amber vehicle outline with exclamation: electric-drive fault; drive very slowly to a qualified workshop
steady amber vehicle outline with exclamation: electric power limited by low high-voltage charge or a temperature limit; distinct from the fault state despite the same base shape
steady amber vehicle outline with sound waves: external engine-sound fault; pedestrians may not hear the vehicle
steady amber turtle in a circle: system power limited because the combustion engine is unavailable; distinct from generic charge/temperature limitation
steady white crossed-out E in a circle: electric mode temporarily unavailable because conditions are not met
reviewed_sections.catalogue_action: All meanings remain individually pending exact reusable graphics. The e-sound meaning matches an existing semantic concept, but its local filled-car asset differs from the exact Terramar outline and is not scoped.
reviewed_sections.scope: Hybrid/PHEV vehicles only; do not transfer to conventional combustion-only versions.

photographed_vehicle_separation: The user-stated manufacture date 03/2026 is not used as evidence of model year, software version or automatic identity with edition 11.25.
